title: Houston says 'Mama, I love you' the day before Thanksgiving

tellings.quote: and I was shocked cuz I had never ever heard heard my son say my name he was 17

plain: A mother in Atlanta, Georgia, named Katie says that the day before Thanksgiving, her son Houston, then about 17, said "Mama, I love you." She says she was shocked, because she had never once heard him say her name before. She told it on a podcast about a documentary called the Telepathy Tapes, which follows children said to communicate by telepathy.
